sloka: स स्वया गदया भग्नो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः।निपपात ततो मत्तो वज्राहत इवाचलः ।। ६.७०.६० ।।
transliteration: sa svayā gadayā bhagno viśīrṇadaśanekṣaṇaḥ।nipapāta tato matto vajrāhata ivācalaḥ ।। 6.70.60 ।।

translations.english: Like a tree whose roots have been severed, the Rakshasa fell on the ground. Then seizing forcibly, the dreadful mace that resembled the rod of Lord of death he roared.
